children: Investors still have a lot of unanswered questions about why Lululemon is struggling so much, Stifel analysts say. Lululemon slides 20% after 2Q sales fall steeply and guidance is cut again. While Lululemon's North American business is continuing to decline, its Mainland China business also had a surprising reversal after previously being the strongest regional contributor to sales, the analysts say. "We believe shares deserve a valuation discount given challenging visibility, poor traffic trends, and new questions around China growth potential," the analysts say.(katherine.hamilton@wsj.com)
